# DOF Update

> DOF Update 2026 is an in-person interprofessional immersion on TMD (DTM), orofacial pain, sleep and evidence-based clinical practice.

Canonical site: https://dofupdate.com.br/
Human-readable fact sheet for assistants: https://dofupdate.com.br/llms.md
Official registration: Even3 checkout after mini-capture on the landing page.
